annotations.title: The Ladder — NFL strike ladders: every Kalshi strike vs the PMP distribution

description: Use for "where does the model disagree with Kalshi on the Rams spread" and "biggest ladder gaps this week". Every NFL strike ladder — spreads, season win totals, player props — with Kalshi's price at each strike beside our distribution and a SHAPE / LOCATION / PRICED / PARTIAL verdict. Our number is published only between 30% and 70%. Free, no key.

limit.description: Max ladders (default 8). Values above 25 are clamped to 25.
